term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address [parameter3].explanation: The command filters traffic based on the specified source IP address (`[parameter3]`) in a Junos policy or rule.

parameters.name: source-address
parameters.explanation: The web address and subnet mask of the source address.

from destination-address [parameter3].explanation: Configure the terms of the firewall filter, specify the destination address.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.
